No new gold annotations were loaded for this review; prior project context already contained scores and outcomes.
The assistant helped develop the artifact and is not independent of it.
No benchmark outputs, frozen inference/analysis sources or official metrics are changed.

These are 30 repeated conditions on six development strings, not 30 independent questions.

rubric.anchor_identity: Subject referent identity; other constraints are assessed in query_meaning to avoid double-counting.

rubric.witness_support: Recorded graph/program/row consistency; supported is not historical truth. Unknown/not-applicable for abstention.
